blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Recent studies have shown that Large Language Models can effectively solve problems and fix bugs in diverse programming environments, including competitive programming. Existing approaches primarily evaluate LLM performance in problem solving or bug fixing independently, but do not explore the relationship between these two capabilities. This work focuses on determining how much the LLM deviates from a buggy solution to fix the bug compared to a human-written patch, and if there is a bias towards generating entirely new solutions. We construct a dataset with all the submissions ( ∼ \sim 3000) from a couple of users from Codeforces, and we match each buggy submission with its corresponding human fix. By using the similarity between the buggy solution and the human fix as a baseline, we evaluate the quality of LLM-generated bug fixes on 3 OpenAI GPT models (gpt-5-nano, gpt-5-mini, gpt-5.1). We check if the generated solutions solve the problem by using the Codeforces-R1 dataset, an openly available dataset that has tests generated with the DeepSeek-R1 model. Our findings suggest that LLMs tend to modify more lines than necessary compared to human fixes and, in some cases, generate entirely new solutions. We also observe that LLMs solve more problems correctly when allowed to generate solutions from scratch rather than patch buggy submissions, even when those submissions are close to the human patch. This has important implications for the design of AI-assisted programming tools, particularly in supporting user debugging processes and promoting incremental problem-solving strategies rather than solution replacement.
blocks.zh: 最近的研究显示,大语言模型可以在包括竞争性编程在内的多种编程环境中有效解决问题和修复bug. 现有方法主要评价LLM在独立解决问题或bug修复中的性能,但不探索这两种能力之间的关系. 这项工作的重点是确定LLM与人文补丁相比,在修复buggy溶液方面,与buggy溶液的偏差有多大,是否偏向于生成全新的溶液. 我们用来自代码部队的几个用户的所有提交(\\sim 3000)构建一个数据集,我们把每个buggy提交与相应的人修匹配. 通过将buggy溶液和人类固定的相似性作为基线,我们评价了3个OpenAI GPT模型(gpt-5-nano,gpt-5-mini,gpt-5.1)上LLM生成bug修复的质量. 我们检查生成的解决方案是否通过使用 CodeForce-R1 数据集来解决问题,这个可公开获取的数据集已经用 DeepSeek-R1 模型生成测试. 我们的调查结果表明,与人类的修补方法相比,法学硕士课程往往比必要的方法更需要修改,在某些情况下,还会产生全新的解决办法。 我们还注意到,如果允许从零开始生成解决方案,而不是补丁错误提交书,则LLMs正确地解决了更多的问题,即使这些提交书接近人类补丁。 这对AI辅助编程工具的设计有重要影响,特别是在支持用户调试进程和促进渐进解决问题战略而不是解决方案替换方面.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Competitive programming is a mind sport in which participants try to come up with solutions to given problems (algorithmic in nature) that must satisfy some constraints. The submission to a given problem is evaluated through multiple test cases that capture various edge cases and inform the user if a constraint is violated. For a given problem to be considered Accepted, one has to pass all the test cases. Besides being a sport, it also represents a method in which a user can learn more about algorithmic design by receiving feedback on their submission by following an iterative debugging process.
blocks.zh: 竞争性编程是一种心灵运动,参与者在这种运动中试图提出一定问题的解决办法(自然界的算术),这些问题必须满足一些限制因素。 向特定问题提交的评估是通过多个测试案例进行的,这些测试案例可以捕捉各种边缘案例,并在违反某项约束时告知用户. 要使某个问题被视为接受,就必须通过所有测试案例。 它除了是一种运动外,还代表着一种方法,通过遵循迭代调试过程,通过接收关于其提交情况的反馈,用户可以更多地了解算法设计.

blocks.en: The rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs) has driven significant interest in their application to Automatic Program Repair (APR). Prior work has demonstrated that LLMs can both generate solutions to algorithmic problems [ 1 ] and patch buggy code [ 2 ] across a variety of settings. However, existing approaches largely evaluate these two capabilities in isolation, leaving open an important question: when an LLM is given a buggy submission and tasked with fixing it, does it behave like a human debugger — making targeted, minimal edits — or does it tend to discard the original solution and generate a new one from scratch?
blocks.zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)的迅速发展,促使人们对将其应用到自动程序修复(PRA)产生了极大的兴趣. 先前的工作证明,LLMS既可以生成算法问题的解决方案[1],也可以通过各种设置补丁buggy代码[2]. 然而,现有方法基本上孤立地评估这两种能力,留下一个重要问题:当LLM得到一个buggy的呈文并承担修复任务时,它的行为是否像一个人类调试者——做目标明确的,最小的编辑——还是它倾向于抛弃原来的解决方案,从头产生新的解决方案?

blocks.en: This distinction matters beyond mere academic curiosity. In practice, AI-assisted programming tools are increasingly integrated into iterative development workflows, where preserving the user’s intent and code structure is often as important as producing a correct solution. A tool that systematically replaces rather than repairs code undermines the debugging process and offers little support for incremental problem solving.
blocks.zh: 这种区别不仅仅是学术上的好奇。 在实践中,AI辅助编程工具日益融入到迭代开发工作流程中,在这些工作流程中,维护用户的意图和代码结构往往与产生正确解决方案同样重要. 一个系统取代而非修复代码的工具会破坏调试过程,对渐进式解决问题几乎没有什么支持.

blocks.en: In this paper, we introduce a dataset that contains all the submissions from 7 Codeforces [ 3 ] users ( ∼ \sim 3000 submissions), which we use to investigate how various strong closed-source LLMs from the OpenAI family (gpt-5-nano, gpt-5-mini, and gpt-5.1) repair their buggy submissions relative to their own fix. In other words, we identify how well the LLM preserves the original structure of the code in the buggy submission when generating a fix, compared to a human patch. Using 3 methods of prompting: (1) a simple bug fix prompt; (2) a prompt that just generate a solution from scratch; (3) an optimized prompt via Genetic-Pareto (GEPA) [ 4 ] , a prompt optimization technique, we compare the similarity between the buggy problem and the generated fix to the similarity between the buggy problem and the human fix. We also use Codeforces-R1 [ 5 ] dataset to evaluate the solutions for each problem using coding tests generated by DeepSeek-R1 [ 6 ] to determine if the code is correct. With this in mind, we investigate the following research questions: – RQ1: Given a buggy submission, how well does the LLM preserve the original user’s structure when fixing the bug? – RQ2 : Are language models better at generating code that solves a problem than at fixing bugs? – RQ3 : Is there a relationship between how much the AI preserves the user’s original code structure and its ability to correctly fix the bug?
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们引入了一个数据集,其中包含来自7个代码力量[3]用户的所有提交(\\sim 3,000提交),我们用该数据集来调查OpenAI家族(gpt-5-nano,gpt-5-mini,和gpt-5.1)的各种强闭源有限责任公司如何相对自己的固定修复其buggy提交. 换句话说,我们确定LLM在生成固定符时,与人类补丁相比,在buggy提交文中如何保存代码的原始结构. 采用3种提示方法: (1)简单的bug修补即时; (2)只是从头产生一个解决方案的即时; (3)通过Gene-Pareto(GEPA)[4]优化的即时优化技术,将buggy问题与生成的修复之间的相似性与buggy问题与人类修复之间的相似性进行比较. 我们还使用CodeForce-R1[5]数据集,利用DeepSeek-R1[6]生成的编码测试来评价每个问题的解决方案,以确定代码是否正确. 考虑到这一点,我们调查了以下研究问题: — RQ1: 鉴于一个错误提交, LLM在修复错误时保存原始用户的结构有多好? — RQ2 : 语言模型是否比修复错误更能生成解决问题的代码? - 问题3: AI保存了多少用户的原始代码结构与其正确修复错误的能力之间是否存在关系?

blocks.en: In summary, this paper makes the following contributions: (1) We introduce a dataset of  3,000 submissions from 7 Codeforces users, capturing complete submission histories including buggy and accepted solutions. (2) We systematically evaluate three prompting strategies — bug fix, scratch generation, and GEPA-optimized — across three OpenAI models on their ability to repair buggy code. (3) We propose and apply a structural similarity analysis to measure how faithfully LLM-generated fixes preserve the original code, comparing it against human patches. (4) We provide empirical answers to the interplay between structural preservation and correctness, with implications for AI-assisted debugging tools in educational and professional contexts.
blocks.zh: 简言之,本文件作出以下贡献: (1) 我们采用了由7个代码部队用户提交的3 000份呈件组成的数据集,收集完整的呈件历史,包括buggy和被接受的解决方案。 (2)我们系统评价三种激励策略——虫修复,刮伤生成,以及GEPA优化——在三种OpenAI模型中评价它们修复虫密码的能力. (3)我们提出并应用结构相似性分析,以衡量LLM生成的修复如何忠实地保存原始代码,将其与人类补丁进行比较. (4) 我们对结构保存与正确性之间的相互作用提供经验性答案,在教育和专业方面对人工智能辅助调试工具产生影响。

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A Evaluation of LLMs in Solving Competitive Programming Problems
blocks.zh: II-A 评价解决竞争性方案拟订问题方面的法学硕士学位

blocks.en: Zheng et al. [ 7 ] have observed that the current models excel in cases of implementation and derivation of competitive programming solutions, while they perform significantly worse on problems that require heavy observation. At the same time, LLMs alone struggle to solve hard problems or unseen problems, but human-LLM collaboration significantly improves task performance [ 8 ] . The same study finds that this is also true for bug identification. A problem identified by both papers is that data contamination is a common problem in competitive programming evaluation of LLMs.
blocks.zh: 郑等. [7] 已注意到,现行模式在执行和产生竞争性方案拟订解决办法方面表现优异,而在需要认真观察的问题方面则表现差得多。 同时,单是LLM就努力解决困难问题或未见的问题,但人与LLM合作大大改善了任务性能[8]. 同一研究发现,在识别错误方面也是如此. 这两份文件都指出的一个问题是,数据污染是有限责任公司竞争性方案拟订评价中的一个常见问题。

blocks.en: II-B Evaluation of LLMs in Fixing Bugs in Competitive Programming Problems
blocks.zh: II-B 评估在竞争性方案拟订问题上纠正错误的法学硕士学位

blocks.en:
Some recent works explored the capabilities of language models to fix incorrect competitive programming solutions. DebugBench [ 9 ] is a benchmark with different types of bugs that was constructed via bug implantation with various LLMs on submissions from LeetCode. After a rigorous human evaluation, multiple LLMs are evaluated against the benchmark and the results suggest that LLMs tend to perform better on syntax and reference errors compared to logical errors. Mavalankar et al. [ 10 ] introduce a golden set of example buggy / fix code pairs that is then used to enhance the performance of LLMs in bug fixing.
In [ 11 ] two Language Models (PLBart [ 12 ] and CodeT5 [ 13 ] ) were evaluated in the context of program repair on n-gram based metrics and execution based metrics based on (bug fix, human fix) pairs, and it was found that the n-gram based metrics are suboptimal in comparison with the execution based metrics.
A bug fix should be as localized as possible, and it should not change the structure of the code unless the user explicitly wants this. Most existing works focus on the capacity of LLMs to solve bugs, but not on how they are solved. To fill this gap, our work explores the differences between the human fixes and the generated fixes as well in terms of modified lines and correctness. To this aspect, the only similar work is from Dai et al. [ 14 ] that has also explored fixing bugs in competitive programming with minimal modifications by defining the consistency of a fix as the ratio between preserved lines and the number of lines in the fixed code. We further expand this metric by also penalizing the lines that are deleted from the initial code. Even though there may be cases where these lines are not actually used anywhere, deleting them is a deviation from what the user asked.
blocks.zh:
最近的一些著作探讨了语言模型修复不正确的竞争性编程解决方案的能力. Debug Bench [9] 是一个具有不同类型bug的基准,通过bug植入在LetCode提交文件上使用各种LLMs构建. 经过严格的人文评价,对照基准评价多个LLM,结果显示,与逻辑错误相比,LLM在语法和参考错误方面往往表现更好. 马瓦兰卡尔等人. [10]引入了一套金色的示例buggy / 固定代码对,然后用来增强LLMs在bug修复中的性能.
在[11]两个语言模型(PLBart [12]和CodeT5 [13])中,在基于n克的度量衡的程序修复和基于对(bug fix, human fix)的执行度量衡的背景下进行了评价,发现与基于执行的度量衡相比,n克的度量衡是次优的.
一个bug修正应该尽可能本地化,除非用户明确要求,否则它不应该改变代码的结构. 大多数现存的作品都关注LLMs解决bug的能力,但并不关注如何解决bug. 为了填补这一空白,我们的工作探索了人类修补与生成的修补之间以及在修改线条和正确性方面的差异。 在这方面,仅有的类似作品来自戴等人. [14],也探索了在竞争性编程中用最小的修改来固定bug,将固定的一致定义为固定代码中保存的行数和行数之间的比例. 我们进一步扩大这一衡量标准,还惩罚从最初的代码中删除的线条。 即使可能存在这些线条没有在任何地方实际使用的情况,删除这些线条就是偏离了用户的要求.

blocks.en: III Method
blocks.zh: 三、结 论 方法

blocks.en: III-A Dataset Creation
blocks.zh: 三-A 数据集创建

blocks.en: Detecting if a LLM is generating a solution from scratch for a buggy submission instead of actually fixing the bug requires the following: (1) problem specification; (2) a suite of tests on which a generated solution can be verified that is correct; (3) a buggy submission; (4) a human-authored corrected submission that fixes the errors in the buggy submission. The similarity between the buggy submission and the correct one can be used as a threshold γ \gamma that identifies if the generated solution deviates too much from the buggy submission or makes fewer modifications than the human to fix the bug.
blocks.zh: 检测一个LLM是否从头开始生成一个用于buggy提交而不是实际修复bug的溶液,需要下列方法:(1) 问题规格;(2) 一套可以核实生成的溶液正确无误的测试;(3) buggy提交;(4) 由人授权校正的提交,纠正buggy提交中的错误. buggy提交与正确提交之间的相似性可以用作一个阈值 γ\gamma,该阈值可以识别生成的溶液是否偏离buggy提交过多,或者进行比人类少的修改来修复bug.

blocks.en: For (1) and (2), we used Codeforces-R1, a dataset with over 10k unique problems extracted from Codeforces along with public test cases and test cases generated with Deepseek-R1. The team behind Codeforces-R1 offers a dataset for submissions (over 12M) as well, but the distributions of verdicts is highly unbalanced, 99% of the submissions being submissions that have Accepted as a verdict. The rest of submissions are buggy submissions that are sparse and cannot be connected with the correct Accepted submissions, so this dataset is not suitable for (3) and (4).
blocks.zh: 对于(1)和(2),我们使用了Codeforce-R1,这个数据集从Codeforce中提取了超过10k个独特的问题,以及用Deepseek-R1生成的公共测试案例和测试案例. 代码Force-R1背后的团队也提供了提交(超过12M)的数据集,但判决的分布极不平衡,99%的提交是已被接受为判决的提交. 其余的提交材料是杂乱无章的提交材料,很少,无法与正确的接受提交材料连接,因此本数据集不适合(3)和(4).

blocks.en: To gather data for paired buggy (3) and human-authored correct (4) submissions, we asked various Competitive programming users to provide all the submissions that they have on Codeforces. All the users, started competing on Codeforces when they were students at BSc level (aged 19) and in some cases continuing to do so at MSc level or after. The submissions span from 2015 to 2025. In this way, for a given problem p p and a user u u , we can extract all the submissions and order them in descending order by date. We consider a solution incorrect if it does not pass all the test cases for that specific problem, or if it does not compile. Ordering by date/time is very important in this case, because it offers the possibility to have different snapshots of a given solution from a user, based on submissions. Let us assume that for a given problem P P , we have n n submissions, s i s_{i} , from the same user u u , where only the last submission s n s_{n} is correct, and the other submissions are wrong. Starting from s 1 s_{1} , one needs to add or delete a couple of lines to get to s 2 s_{2} . The process is repeated from s 2 s_{2} to s 3 s_{3} and so on till s n − 1 s_{n-1} and s n s_{n} . In theory, s n − 1 s_{n-1} submission should have the minimal number of lines that need to be added or deleted to reach an Accepted solution, while s 1 s_{1} should have the maximal number of lines that need to be added or deleted. Having these historical submissions, we could estimate a threshold ( γ \gamma ) that we can use to determine if a solution is generated from scratch by the LLM or it is actually doing a set of minimal modifications to reach a correct solution – thus being a fix. From now on, we refer to s n s_{n} as the anchor solution and s i , i ∈ 1 , 2 . . , n − 1 s_{i},i\in{1,2..,n-1} , as being the buggy solutions that are related to s n s_{n} .
blocks.zh: 为了收集对齐的buggy(3)和人类作者正确的(4)提交材料的数据,我们请各种竞争性编程用户提供他们在代码力量上的所有提交材料。 所有用户在是BSc级(19岁)的学生时开始在Codeforce上竞争,在某些情况下继续在MSc级或之后竞争。 提交资料的时间跨度为2015年至2025年。 这样,对于给定的问题p和用户u u,我们可以提取所有提交材料,并按日期顺序依次排列. 我们认为,如果这一具体问题没有通过所有测试,或者没有汇编,解决办法是不正确的。 在这种情况下,按日期/时间排序非常重要,因为它有可能根据提交材料,从用户那里获得对某一解决方案的不同快照。 让我们假设,对于一个特定的问题P P, 我们有 n 提交, s i s_{i},来自同一个用户u u, 在那里,只有最后的提交s n s_{n] 是正确的, 而其他提交都是错误的. 从s 1 s% 1} 开始, 需要添加或删除几行才能得到s 2 s% 2} 。 过程从s 2 s_{2}到s 3 s_{3}等等,一直持续到s − 1 s_{n-1}和s _{n}。 在理论上,s n − 1 s_{n-1} 提交书应该有需要添加或删除的最小行数才能达成一个接受的解决方案,而s 1 s_{1}应该有需要添加或删除的最大行数. 在提交这些历史材料之后,我们可以估计出一个阈值( γ\gamma ) , 我们可以用来确定一个解决方案是由LLM从零开始产生的, 或者它实际上正在做一系列微小的修改以达成一个正确的解决方案 — — 因此是一个固定的解决方案。 从今以后,我们将 sn s_{n} 称为锚溶液 和 si, i → 1, 2 , n − 1 s_{i}, i\ in{ 1, 2., n-1} 称为与 sn_{n} 相关的buggy 溶液 。

blocks.en: In practice, the following scenarios usually happen: (1) An user could have more than one Accepted solution to a given problem (e.g. trying a different approach); (2) The buggy solutions could be very similar to each other in relation to a given anchor (e.g. there is a small error which the user is not figuring out); (3) The buggy solutions could be very different from the anchor solution. The user has multiple buggy submissions, and then it figures out that the whole approach is wrong and reimplements everything from scratch. To solve (1), we order in descending order and determine the anchor in a greedy manner. Iterating over the submissions, whenever the verdict of a given submission s i s_{i} is Accepted, we create a new anchor a i a_{i} and we attach to it the following submissions s i + 1 , s i + 2 ​ … s_{i+1},s_{i+2}... till we encounter another Accepted solution. Point (2) is not a problem but a useful property. These submissions could be considered as small augmentations of a buggy solution that check the consistency of LLMs’ output. For case (3), we choose to retain only the buggy submissions that have a similarity of at least 60 % with the correct submission. Anything less than 60% increases the chance of having a re-implementation, where the anchor transforms from a bug fixing solution to a new solution altogether. Comparing the LLM’s generated solution to an anchor like this would change the focus from comparing the code in terms of bug fixing modifications to modifications that reach an alternative solution. We consider that a threshold of 60 % is high enough to avoid cases of re-implementations in anchors but low enough to capture cases in which a LLM genuinely comes up with a bug fixing that is closer to the original code compared to the anchor. (e.g. the user adds or removes a lot of unnecessary code to fix the bug while a LLM modifies only a couple of lines to fix the bug).
blocks.zh: 在实践中,通常会发生以下情况: (1) 用户可以对某一问题有一个以上接受的解决办法(例如尝试不同的办法); (2) buggy 解决方案在给定主锚上可能非常相似(例如,有一个小错误,用户没有弄清楚); (3)buggy溶液可能与锚溶液有很大不同. 用户有多个buggy的提交,然后它就会发现整个方法是错误的,并且从头开始重新执行一切. 解决(1),我们按降序排序,并以贪婪的方式决定锚. 在提交材料中,每当对某一提交材料s i s_{i}的判决被接受时,我们就建立一个新的主播i a_{i}我们附上以下提交材料s i + 1, s i + 2... s_{i+1},s_{i+2}. 直到我们遇到另一个接受的解决方案. 第(2)点不是一个问题,而是一个有用的财产。 这些提交材料可视为对限制有限责任公司产出一致性的buggy解决方案的小规模增强。 对于案例(3),我们选择只保留与正确提交内容相近至少60%的buggy提交内容. 如果低于60%,则会增加重新实施的机会,因为锚会从修复错误的解决方案转变为全新的解决方案。 把 LLM 生成的解决方案比作这样的主锚, 将改变焦点, 将代码从修复错误的修改到实现替代解决方案的修改进行比较。 我们认为,60%的阈值足够高,可以避免在锚中重新实施的情况,但低到能够捕捉到LLM真正出现一个比锚更接近原始代码的bug修饰的情况。 (例如,用户添加或删除了大量不必要的代码来修复错误,而LLM只修改几行来修复错误).

blocks.en: IV Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 四 实验设置

blocks.en: Using the preprocessed dataset, we evaluate 3 strong closed-source LLMs from the OpenAI family (gpt-5-nano, gpt-5-mini, gpt-5.1) using three prompting methods: NaiveBugFix, GenerateScratch, GEPABugFix. For all the methods, we make use of DSPy prompt optimization framework [ 15 ] to define the prompts. For each LLM, we use a medium reasoning effort. In DSPy, we use a Predictor Module instead of ChainOfThought (COT) module, because the models already have an internal reasoning. We limit each LLM to 32k tokens. For gpt-5.1 we also investigate how the model performs with no reasoning. We split the initial preprocessed dataset by problem into 3 folds: (1) train fold - 15 % problems (2) validation fold - 15 % problems (3) test fold - 70 % problems. We chose to split the preprocessed dataset by problem instead of submission to avoid data leakage. We use the train and validation folds for GEPA prompt optimization – as GEPA is very data efficient and requires a small number of samples, and we test all the models on the test fold.
blocks.zh: 我们利用预先处理过的数据集,利用三种提示方法评估OpenAI家族的3种强闭源LLM(gpt-5-nano,gpt-5-mini,gpt-5.1): NaiveBugFix, GenerateScratch, GEPABugFix (英语). 对于所有的方法,我们使用DSPy即时优化框架[15]来定义提示. 每一个LLM,我们使用 中等推理努力。 在DSPy中,我们使用一个Predictor模块而不是ChainOfThought(COT)模块,因为模型已经有一个内部推理. 我们把每个LLM限制在32k的符号. 对于gpt-5.1,我们也调查模型如何在没有推理的情况下进行. 我们通过问题将初始的预处理数据集分成3个折叠:(1)列车折叠——15%问题(2)验证折叠——15%问题(3)测试折叠——70%问题. 我们选择将预处理的数据集按问题划分,而不是提交以避免数据泄露. 我们使用列车和验证折叠进行GEPA的即时优化 — — 因为GEPA的数据效率很高,需要少量的样本,我们测试测试折叠上的所有模型.

blocks.en: IV- 1 NaiveBugFix
blocks.zh: 四 - 1 纳伊夫·布格菲克斯

blocks.en: We create a simple prompt that asks the LLM to generate a fix for a buggy submission on a given problem (by generating the entire code), while keeping the number of deleted or added lines as low as possible. The prompt can be seen in Figure 2 .
blocks.zh: 我们创建一个简单的提示,请 LLM 为特定问题的buggy 提交生成一个固定(通过生成整个代码),同时尽可能降低删除或添加的行数 。 图2显示了提示。

blocks.en:
NaiveBugFixPrompt Fix the bug in the buggy code for the given competitive programming problem by adding, deleting or modifying as few lines as possible.
In other words, you must adhere to the given buggy code and change it as little as possible to make it work. You can add, delete or modify lines of code, but you cannot rewrite the whole solution. The more lines you change, the more points you lose. You should try to find the bug and fix it, not to rewrite the whole solution. Inputs: problem_description , input_format , output_format , examples , note (optional) , programmingLanguage , submission_verdict , buggy_code Output: fixed_code — The complete fixed code encapsulated in a cpp block.

NaiveBugFix Prompt 软件 通过添加,删除或修改尽可能多的行来修正给定的竞争性编程问题的buggy代码中的bug.
换句话说,你必须坚持给定的buggy代码,并尽可能少地修改,使其发挥作用. 您可以添加,删除或修改代码行,但不能重写整个解决方案. 换行越多,积分就越少. 你应该试着找到错误并修复它,而不是重写整个解决方案. 输入:问题_描述,输入_格式,输出_格式,示例,注释(可选),编程 语言、 提交_ 核查、 buggy_ 代码 输出: 固定_代码 - 完整的固定代码封装在一个cpp块中.

blocks.en: Given the NaiveBugFix as a starting point, we employ GEPA as a prompt optimization technique. We use as a prediction model gpt-5-nano and as a reflection model gpt-5-mini, with medium reasoning, a maximum 32k tokens and 2 full evaluations over the validation dataset. To optimize the prompt, GEPA requires a metric function that returns values between [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] . To convert our s ​ i ​ m r ​ a ​ t ​ i ​ o sim_{ratio} metric into a function that has values between 0 and 1, we use the following reward function: r ​ e ​ w ​ a ​ r ​ d = p ​ a ​ s ​ s ∗ m ​ i ​ n ​ ( 1 , s ​ i ​ m r ​ a ​ t ​ i ​ o ) reward=pass*min(1,sim_{ratio}) . Note that p ​ a ​ s ​ s ∈ { 0 , 1 } pass\in\{0,1\} . Basically, if the generated solution does not fix the bug, then we return 0, since the similarity is not relevant in this case, and thus forcing GEPA to find a prompt that prioritizes bug fixing. If the bug is fixed, then we return the s ​ i ​ m r ​ a ​ t ​ i ​ o sim_{ratio} . Note that if s ​ i ​ m r ​ a ​ t ​ i ​ o > 1 sim_{ratio}>1 , we trim it to 1 since we already have a solution that is better or equal with the baseline. GEPA allows for textual feedback in the metric function. The entire flow can be seen in Figure 4 .

blocks.en: V- 2 RQ2: Are models better at generating code that solves a problem than at fixing bugs?
blocks.zh: V -2 RQ2: (英语). 模型是否比修复错误更能生成解决问题的代码?

blocks.en: In the case of gpt-nano, there seems to be ∼ \sim 0.15 drop for bug fixing compared to generating from scratch, and for gpt-mini as well in some similarity ranges. For the other models, this drop happens in various similarity ranges as well, with the exception of gpt 5.1 in the [0.9 - 1] range. This suggests that LLMs are better at generating a solution from scratch than at bug fixing. Besides this, we can observe that increasing the model capacity increases the score on a task level but doesn’t always reduce the gap between the tasks. This can be observed on the [0.6 - 0.7) and [0.8 - 0.9) ranges. Also, reasoning seems to have a big impact on the ratio of problems solved since gpt-5.1-no-reason has low scores. The superiority of LLMs at generating solutions from scratch over fixing bugs may create a misleading expectation in users. Since debugging intuitively feels like a more constrained and therefore easier task than solving a problem from scratch, users may incorrectly assume that LLMs should excel at it when the evidence suggests the opposite.
blocks.zh: 就gpt-nano而言,似乎有 \\sim 0.15 滴,用于修复bug 而不是从头生成,以及一些相似范围内的gpt-mini 。 对于其他模型,这种下降也发生在各种相似性范围,但[0.9-1]范围内的gpt 5.1除外. 这表明LLMS比在修复错误时更能从头产生一个解决方案. 除此之外,我们可以看到,增加模型容量会在任务层面提高分数,但并不总是缩小任务之间的差距。 在[0.6 - 0.7]和[0.8 - 0.9]范围内可以看到这一点。 另外,推理似乎对Gpt-5.1-无理性的分数低而解决问题的比例有较大影响. LLMs在从零开始生成解决方案时优于修复bug,可能会在用户中产生误导性的预期. 由于调试直觉感觉比从零解决一个问题更受约束,因此更容易完成任务,用户可能会错误地假设LLMs在证据表明相反时应该优异.

blocks.en: V- 4 Discussion summary
blocks.zh: 五、四 讨论摘要

blocks.en: - From the results above, it can be seen that the LLMs are better at the task of generating a solution from scratch to a given problem (especially lower capacity models which may be overfitted on the task) than on the task of bug fixing with minimal modifications. Having a complex prompt that forces the model to minimize the number of modified lines when fixing a bug increases the s ​ i ​ m r ​ a ​ t ​ i ​ o ¯ \overline{sim_{ratio}} but decreases the ratio of solved problems while a more simpler prompt decreases the s ​ i ​ m r ​ a ​ t ​ i ​ o ¯ \overline{sim_{ratio}} and increases the number of problems solved. These findings point to open challenges for AI-assisted debugging tools. One promising direction is to adapt how strictly the model is constrained based on how large the fix needs to be — enforcing minimal edits only when the required change is small.
blocks.zh: - 从上述结果可以看出,LLMs更有能力从零到特定问题生成一个解决方案(特别是可能过于适合任务的低容量模型),而不是在最小修改的情况下修复bug的任务。 具有一个复杂的提示,在修复错误时强制模型将修改的行数最小化会增加 s i m r a i o \ overline{sim_{rtio}}},但降低已解决问题的比例,同时更简单的提示会减少 s i m r a o o o o overline{sim_{rtio}}}并增加已解决问题的数量. 这些调查结果表明AI辅助调试工具面临挑战。 一个有希望的方向就是根据固定装置需要多大来调整模型的严格限制程度——只有在要求的更改很小时才执行最小的编辑.

blocks.en: VI Reproducibility
blocks.zh: 六、可复制性

blocks.en: The code, GEPA model and dataset can be found on Github . All the experiments were conducted using Docker to ensure reproducibility. Each generated solution was tested against tests by using the solution suggested on the Codeforces-R1 Huggingface page. For the entire study, we have consumed ∼ \sim 20 million tokens with a price of ∼ \sim 80$.

blocks.en: VII Conclusion
blocks.zh: 七. 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we have investigated how LLMs perform when they are required to fix bugs with minimal modifications. We have found that LLMs are better at generating solutions from scratch than at bug fixing with minimal modifications especially when the number of modified lines in the human fix is very small. Besides this, we have also found that defining a more complex prompt to reduce the number of modifications has a negative impact on the capacity of the model to correctly solve a problem. This suggests that LLMs may not propose bug fixes that are consistent with the initial code and perform other modifications that the user does not expect. Since LLMs perform better at generating solutions from scratch, they may be tempted to rewrite rather than minimally fix code. This is problematic in any domain where the original structure carries value — such as education, where it supports learning; collaborative development, where it aids code review; or legacy systems, where large rewrites introduce risk and break established conventions.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们调查了LLMs在要求它们用最小的修改来修补错误时的表现. 我们发现 LLMs 更能从头产生解决方案, 除此之外,我们还发现,确定一个更复杂的速报以减少修改次数,对模型正确解决问题的能力有负面影响. 这表明LLMS可能不会提出符合初始代码的bug修正,并进行用户不期望的其他修改. 由于LLMS在从零开始生成解决方案方面表现较好,它们可能会被诱惑重写而不是最低限度固定代码. 这在原始结构具有价值的任何领域都是有问题的——例如教育,它支持学习;合作发展,它协助代码审查;或遗留系统,大型改写引入风险和打破既定公约。

blocks.en:
As future work we would like to extend the study to LLMs from other vendors as well to understand if the effects replicate. We would also like to extend the dataset to contain more users and track how the gap between scratch generation and bug fixing evolves as newer, more recent submissions are introduced. We also want to analyze how the effects manifest based on problem difficulty and judge verdicts.
Besides this, we are also interested to evaluate the model performance on cases in which they are allowed to have more than 1 call per submission and to further explore the impact of prompt complexity on the relation between preserving the structure and fixing the buggy submission.
blocks.zh:
作为今后的工作,我们希望将研究扩大到其他供应商的有限责任公司,以便了解这些影响是否重复。 我们还希望扩大数据集,以包含更多的用户,并跟踪抓取生成与修复错误之间的差距如何随着较新的、较近期的提交而演变。 我们还希望根据问题的困难分析这些影响如何表现,并判断判决。
除此之外,我们还有兴趣评估模式性能,即允许他们每次提交一次以上的呼叫,并进一步探讨迅速的复杂性对维护结构和确定提交错误之间的关系的影响。
